blockingIssues.description: Stream mode `-c -v` parity mismatch: `search_stream_count` ignores invert semantics and reports matching-line counts instead of baseline invert counts.
Stream mode panics on non-UTF8 stdin due to `read_to_string(...).expect(...)`, while baseline handles byte streams without panic.
Invalid `-G/--file-search-regex` values are silently ignored instead of returning baseline-compatible invalid-regex diagnostics and exit semantics.
Context rendering drops output for non-UTF8 files because `read_to_string` failures short-circuit output, diverging from baseline byte-tolerant behavior.
Missing argument handling for `--path-to-ignore`/`-p` is misclassified and falls back to generic query-missing error instead of baseline invalid-option diagnostics.
`is_binary_buf` incorrectly skips final suspicious-byte ratio check for short buffers (`total_bytes < 32`), causing traversal scope mismatches with baseline binary classification.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require explicit edge-case verification for stream/context non-UTF8 handling and stream `-c -v` parity in CLI milestones.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Blocking issues appeared in both `rust-cli-count-filename-stream-parity` and `rust-cli-context-color-filter-help-version` due to missing byte-oriented/stream-edge validation.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require invalid-option validation to include missing-value cases for options that require arguments (not only unknown-flag cases).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `rust-cli-exit-and-invalid-diagnostics` passed unknown-option tests but missed `--path-to-ignore`/`-p` missing-argument parity mismatch.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify whether parity validation must compare stderr bytes/channels in addition to stdout+exit, and enforce that requirement consistently in tooling and acceptance checks.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review for `rust-cli-exit-and-invalid-diagnostics` identified mismatch between library claims (stdout/stderr/exit) and current parity runner behavior (stdout+exit only).

rejectedObservations.observation: Add a separate guidance item for UTF-8-only context fixtures.
